content:
Overview

Kazan is a city in Tatarstan with a population of 1,260,000. The capital of Tatarstan, a vibrant city where Russian and Tatar cultures blend, famous for its stunning white Kremlin and mosque. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
